steps.name: distil
steps.note: Under an open-ended barrel with a cold-water pan on top, the water swapped 2–4 times per run.

arkhi.text: Nothing is added here; the fermented milk already holds the alcohol. It is heated in a pot under an open-ended barrel; vapour condenses on a pan of cold water at the top and drips into a vessel hung in the barrel (closed) or runs out through a tap (open). The first spirit is the strongest, later runs weaker. What stays in the pot is the still-residue cheese. Sources disagree on the strength; no temperatures are given.

stillCheese.text: Nothing is added: the heated, soured milk curd stays in the pot while the alcohol leaves. It is pressed by hand or bagged, drained and dried in the sun.
